description: This file defines a class 'Map' within the Opencart admin dashboard module, responsible for retrieving total order counts and amounts grouped by country. It interacts with database tables for orders and countries to generate geographic order summaries.

classes.name: Map
classes.description: A model class for dashboard map operations, specifically retrieving total orders and amounts grouped by country.

methods.name: getTotalOrdersByCountry
methods.description: Retrieves total number and sum of orders for each country based on completed order statuses.
